sections.title: In Aiken *since 1972*
body: Walker Realty Company was established in 1972 and is incorporated in South Carolina.
From its office at 207 Pendleton Street NW, it rents, manages and sells property in Aiken.

items.a: Call (803) 648-3293 to ask what's available now.

items.q: I own a rental. Can you manage it?
items.a: Property management is one of the firm's services. Call to talk it through.

sections.title: Looking for a place?
sections.text: Call the office on Pendleton Street.

before: No website of its own: a search turns up directory pages, one of them misspelled "Walker Reality"
Renters can't see what's available without calling
The first thing a new tenant or owner sees is not something the firm controls
after: A site the business owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room for a list of available rentals and an owner's page as the office supplies them
